assets.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing / product-mockup. Create one polished, photorealistic commercial email banner for Nova União Etiquetas, based on two REAL product photographs supplied as references. Image 1 is the actual blank adhesive label roll with EXACTLY TWO parallel columns of rectangular white labels; Image 2 is the actual continuous roll of blank white cardstock tags with perforated separations. Treat these as product identity references: preserve the paper color, two-column format, rounded label corners, relative proportions, roll cores, stock thickness and recognizable construction; do not invent new product shapes. Art direction: replenishment, ready-to-order label and tag supplies arranged on a dark navy blue packing workbench. One prominent adhesive roll and one tag roll, with a short paper tail, intentionally arranged as a restrained commercial still life. Strong clean white softbox key light, subtle blue rim light, crisp real paper texture, convincing contact shadows. Brand colors: deep navy #010A1B, institutional blue #2967A2 and restrained #4598EF highlights. Avoid artificial neon or glow. Wide horizontal composition, ideally 1536x768 (2:1), product group centered and large, enough safe margin around every product for mobile scaling; no tall empty header space. Background softly recedes into navy. The composition should feel like an art-directed retail supply campaign, not a generic catalog cutout, no collage seams. NO letters, words, prices, barcodes, badges, logos, watermarks, icons, buttons or graphics. All copy and CTA will be live HTML outside this image. This is an illustrative AI-created scene based on real products, not a photo of an actual customer or a warehouse.
